input: Overreliance and unsafe use is a risk associated with A voice-activated virtual assistant is designed to recognize and respond to specific voice commands, providing users with a convenient and hands-free experience. It aims to accurately interpret spoken language, filtering out irrelevant sounds and conversations to minimize false activations. The system seeks to enhance user interaction by offering a range of services and features in response to voice inputs.
